mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gate_lane ORDER BY gate_no, lane_no
SELECT * FROM gate_lane WHERE lane_no = #{laneNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gate_lane (gate_no, lane_no, capacity_per_slot, status, remark) VALUES (#{gateNo}, #{laneNo}, #{capacityPerSlot}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE gate_lane SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM appointment WHERE lane_id = #{laneId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'VERIFIED')

SELECT l.id AS laneId, l.gate_no AS gateNo, l.lane_no AS laneNo, s.time_slot AS timeSlot, IFNULL(c.capacity, l.capacity_per_slot) AS capacity, IFNULL(c.booked_count, 0) AS bookedCount, GREATEST(IFNULL(c.capacity, l.capacity_per_slot) - IFNULL(c.booked_count, 0), 0) AS remain FROM gate_lane l CROSS JOIN ( SELECT '06:00-08:00' AS time_slot UNION ALL SELECT '08:00-10:00' UNION ALL SELECT '10:00-12:00' UNION ALL SELECT '12:00-14:00' UNION ALL SELECT '14:00-16:00' UNION ALL SELECT '16:00-18:00' UNION ALL SELECT '18:00-20:00' UNION ALL SELECT '20:00-22:00' ) s LEFT JOIN appt_slot_capacity c ON c.lane_id = l.id AND c.appt_date = #{date} AND c.time_slot = s.time_slot WHERE l.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY l.gate_no, l.lane_no, s.time_slot
